identity.title: CVE-2026-134802
identity.description: VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade stricter ProxyAuth domain rules by sending percent-encoded path separators. Attackers can request paths with encoded slashes, backslashes, semicolons, or dot segments that match a broader rule, reaching restricted paths once the reverse proxy or backend decodes them.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Access control bypass in authentication proxy software (VoidAuth) evading domain rules, matching identity/access software keep criteria.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134803
identity.description: DBHub before 1.7.0 contains a read-only mode bypass vulnerability that allows MCP clients restricted to readonly execute_sql to run write and DDL statements via backslash-escaped quotes. Attackers can hide stacked statements that clear transaction_read_only or COMMIT inside strings misparsed by scanSingleQuotedString, letting them modify or drop MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL data.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Read-only mode bypass in database management tool (DBHub) affecting major enterprise databases, fitting widely deployed platform software criteria.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134804
identity.description: Portainer 2.39.0 before 2.39.9, 2.40.0 before 2.45.4, and 3.0.0 before 3.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows Standard users to access other users' containers via the WebSocket attach and exec endpoints. Attackers with shared environment access can use leaked container or exec IDs to hijack sessions over /api/websocket/attach or /api/websocket/exec, gaining interactive root shells.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Authorization bypass in widely deployed container management platform (Portainer) allowing privilege escalation to root shells.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134805
identity.description: Zipline before 4.8.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated OIDC users to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs via the userinfo picture claim. Attackers who control their picture claim at the identity provider can force fetchToDataURL() to request internal or cloud-metadata URLs and read responses from their stored avatar.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: SSRF in software processing OIDC identity provider claims, touching identity/access infrastructure with plausible enterprise deployment.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134808
identity.description: Gogs before 0.14.4 on Windows contains a path equivalence vulnerability in isRepositoryGitPath that allows authenticated users with write access to bypass .git directory protection using NTFS aliases. Attackers can create, rename or upload files via aliases like git~1 or .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION to overwrite .git/config or hooks and execute commands as the Gogs process.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Path traversal to command execution in widely deployed Git hosting platform (Gogs), fitting enterprise DevOps infrastructure criteria.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134812
identity.description: msgpackr before 2.1.4 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to cause denial of service by repeatedly re-decoding buffered incomplete values. Attackers can stream a large container of small elements in small chunks to UnpackrStream or decodeIter, triggering quadratic decoding cost that blocks the Node.js event loop.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Remote denial-of-service in widely deployed Node.js serialization library (msgpackr), fitting shared digital commons/platform criteria.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134813
identity.description: Faye websocket-driver 0.5.0 before 0.8.0, permessage-deflate before 0.2.0, and websocket-extensions before 0.2.0 contain a decompression bomb vulnerability because messages are fully inflated before maxLength is enforced. Unauthenticated remote clients negotiating permessage-deflate can send highly compressible messages, forcing processIncomingMessage() to allocate excessive memory and crash the server process.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-409: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification)

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated remote decompression bomb in widely deployed WebSocket libraries, impacting core internet infrastructure and public-facing services.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134814
identity.description: binary-parser before 2.3.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers controlling parser definitions to inject JavaScript through string-typed options passed unvalidated by Context.generateOption(). Attackers can supply crafted length, lengthInBytes, key, tag, offset, or namely() alias values to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the Node.js process when the parser is compiled.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

_relevance.reason: Widely deployed Node.js library with code injection vulnerability affecting enterprise supply chains; platform software keep per overlay.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134815
identity.description: simple-git before 4.1.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the allowUnsafePack guard by supplying the --exec option to non-push git operations. Attackers who influence arguments passed to listRemote() or raw() can inject --exec for ls-remote, archive, fetch-pack or send-pack to execute commands on the host.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-88: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')

_relevance.reason: Popular Node.js Git wrapper used in CI/CD and enterprise automation with command injection; platform software keep per overlay.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134816
identity.description: sigstore-js @sigstore/oci before 0.8.0 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that leaks registry credentials by replaying OAuth2 password-grant request bodies on cross-origin 307 or 308 redirects. Attackers who can make a trusted token service redirect to their host via open redirect or compromise receive the username and password POSTed by RegistryClient.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-201: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data

_relevance.reason: Credential exposure in Sigstore OCI client, a core software supply chain security component; enterprise footprint and credential leak mechanism.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134817
identity.description: mcp-server-kubernetes before 4.2.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows remote MCP clients to inject kubectl flags by supplying dash-prefixed values as positional operands in tools such as exec_in_pod, kubectl_patch, and kubectl_logs. Attackers connected over SSE or Streamable HTTP transport can supply values like --filename to make kubectl read files from the server host, bypassing file-read restrictions.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-88: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')

_relevance.reason: Kubernetes MCP server with argument injection enabling arbitrary file read; enterprise infrastructure footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134818
identity.description: oasdiff 1.24.0 before 1.34.1 fails to enforce --allow-external-refs=false when --open is used, because the recordingReader() capture reader in load/capture.go never applies the external-reference policy. Attackers supplying an untrusted OpenAPI spec can use external $ref values to read local files or trigger HTTP requests, with contents uploaded in the review bundle.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

cwe_names.CWE-610: Externally Controlled Reference to a Resource in Another Sphere

_relevance.reason: API development tool with SSRF and local file read via crafted OpenAPI specs; plausible enterprise CI/CD footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134819
identity.description: Delta Sharing reference server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows share recipients to read unshared data via container-scoped Azure SAS tokens. Recipients with a valid bearer token can request credentials from the temporary-table-credentials endpoint to read every blob in the storage container, including unshared tables.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-732: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

_relevance.reason: Enterprise data-sharing platform with incorrect permission assignment enabling unauthorized data access; plausible DPI/enterprise footprint.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134821
identity.description: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

_relevance.reason: Widely deployed Python web server with unauthenticated remote DoS; public-facing platform software keep per overlay.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134825
identity.description: Gradio 6.27.0 before 6.32.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in gradio/history.py that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to use the operator's locally saved Hugging Face token by sending a forged Host: localhost header. When ssr_mode is enabled, requests proxied through the local Node SSR server pass the loopback check, letting attackers call run history endpoints to list buckets, read records and assets, and write buckets under the operator's account.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Authentication bypass in widely used ML framework enabling token abuse; platform software with identity/access weakness.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134826
identity.description: erxes before 3.4.14 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the insurance_api plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to create, overwrite or delete contract templates via GraphQL mutations. Attackers can inject HTML into templates rendered by headless Chromium during generateContractPDF to pull internal network content into PDFs and exfiltrate customer fields.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

identity.title: CVE-2026-134827
identity.description: Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess that sends the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. Project developers can set the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server and capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository, gaining access to every reachable repository.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

identity.title: CVE-2026-134829
identity.description: Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers holding a user's password to bypass lockout. Attackers can send many concurrent POST requests to /api/2fa/verify that pass checkRateLimit before recordFailedAttempt runs, brute-forcing TOTP or backup codes beyond the five-attempt limit.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Two-factor authentication lockout bypass in self-hosted analytics platform Umami, matching identity/access weakness criteria with plausible enterprise deployment.

identity.title: CVE-2026-134830
identity.description: Casdoor before 4.27.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in decodeSamlMessage that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by sending unbounded DEFLATE-compressed SAML messages. Attackers can send a small, highly compressed SAMLRequest or SAMLResponse to the /api/saml/logout/:owner/:application endpoint, which inflates to gigabytes and crashes or stalls the server.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-409: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification)

identity.title: CVE-2026-134836
identity.description: Dashy 4.0.0 before 4.9.12 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability in isLocalRequest that attaches user credentials to lookalike hosts due to prefix-only origin checks. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted ?config= link pointing to a lookalike host, capturing bearer tokens or HTTP auth headers to read configuration and stored API keys, or modify them when the victim is an admin.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

identity.title: CVE-2026-134624
identity.description: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. identity.title: CVE-2026-134623
identity.description: A flaw has been found in Microweber up to 2.0.20. Patch name: e639d26e61b989b100f8b6f6bb78c0cecca79b99. You should upgrade the affected component.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

identity.title: CVE-2026-134654

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED
